description: Matches the provided value against a regex and returns the capture groups for each match
label: Regex Extract Groups

options.name: regex
options.label: Regex
options.info: The regular expression pattern to match against the value. Use parentheses to capture groups, e.g. '(?<user>\w+)@(?<domain>\w+)' for named groups.

options.name: flagCaseInsensitive
options.label: Case insensitive
options.info: Adds the 'i' flag. Ignores letter case when matching.

options.name: flagMultiline
options.label: Multiline
options.info: Adds the 'm' flag. Makes '^' and '$' match the start/end of each line instead of the whole string.

options.name: flagSingleLine
options.label: Single line (dotall)
options.info: Adds the 's' flag. Makes '.' match newline characters as well.

options.name: flagUnicode
options.label: Unicode
options.info: Adds the 'u' flag. Treats the pattern as a sequence of Unicode code points.

options.name: flagSticky
options.label: Sticky
options.info: Adds the 'y' flag. Matches only from the position given by the regex's lastIndex, so subsequent matches must be contiguous.

options.name: value
options.label: Value to match
options.info: The value to match using the regex.

options.name: schemaModel
options.label: Schema Model
options.info: The schema model to use for the output type.

options.name: result
options.label: Output
options.info: An array with one entry per match: 'match' is the full matched text, 'groups' is an array of the numbered capture groups, 'namedGroups' is an object of any named capture groups.
